title: Agentic Dependency Transformations: Lessons from an Exploratory Case Study of Flask
abstract: arXiv:2610.21372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern software relies heavily on third-party libraries, requiring maintainers to balance the benefits of reuse against dependency-related maintenance and risk. We define dependency transformation as an emerging approach in which an AI coding agent alters how a repository handles external dependencies. Local reimplementation is one transformation strategy that recreates required functionality as local code; dependency transformation is broader and may include other strategies. In this emerging-results paper, we report an exploratory case study of Flask to explore dependency transformation strategies. We design experiments that show how available context shapes an agent's dependency discovery and iterative transformation of dependencies. The case yields five preliminary lessons. These lessons and the five-part research agenda position dependency transformation as an emerging research direction and motivate explicit transformation contract

translated_title: 智能体驱动的依赖转换：来自Flask探索性案例研究的经验教训
translated_abstract: 现代软件高度依赖第三方库，维护者需要在复用带来的好处与依赖相关的维护成本和风险之间进行权衡。我们将“依赖转换”定义为一种新兴方法，即由AI编程智能体改变仓库处理外部依赖的方式。本地重新实现是一种转换策略，它将所需功能重新实现为本地代码；而依赖转换的范围更广，可能包含其他策略。在这篇新兴成果论文中，我们报告了一项针对Flask的探索性案例研究，以探索依赖转换策略。我们设计了实验，展示可用上下文如何塑造智能体对依赖的发现以及对依赖的迭代式转换。该案例总结出五点初步经验教训。这些经验教训以及五部分组成的研究议程将依赖转换确立为一个新兴的研究方向，并促使人们提出显式的“转换契约”这一概念。
tldr: 本文通过对Flask框架的探索性案例研究，首次提出“依赖转换”这一新兴概念——即AI编程智能体改变软件仓库处理外部依赖的方式，总结出五点初步经验教训，并将其确立为一个具有五部分研究议程的新兴研究方向。
en_tdlr: This exploratory case study of Flask introduces "dependency transformation" as an emerging approach in which AI coding agents alter how repositories handle external dependencies, yielding five preliminary lessons and a five-part research agenda for this new research direction.
